source: Guff Tumble boards for 11 and 12 Nov 2026 (#1 and #2), worked out with src/index.js boardFor(); longest words and GuffBot's everyday pick from bestWords()

items.prompt: The nine letters from Guff Tumble #1 (11 November). How long a word can you fold in 33 seconds?
items.detail: R  I  T  E  O  J  B  L  E
items.reveal: Eight letters: BOERTJIE, the only one. GuffBot's everyday pick was TREBLE.
